# Flower of Heaven

> Botanical home and garden decor shop with fresh flower delivery. Decor products are sold and shipped through Amazon.com by Love$Care Store (direct Amazon listings, not affiliate links). The home page also shows Chambelli store picks. Fresh bouquets are delivered by local florists through our partner Florist One.

- [Set of 4 Botanical Canvas Wall Art Prints](https://flowerofheaven.store/shop/botanical-canvas-wall-art/): Sage green eucalyptus and plant prints, 8 x 10 in each, framed and ready to hang. $32.99 at last check; buy at https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HPJZYJYS

- [Christmas Teardrop Swag with Red Bow](https://flowerofheaven.store/shop/christmas-teardrop-swag/): Handmade artificial pine swag with frosted greenery, berries, ornaments and a big red bow. $29.99 at last check; buy at https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HPJN49P4

## Fresh flower delivery
- [Send Flowers](https://flowerofheaven.store/flowers/): Bouquets for birthdays, anniversaries, love, get well, new baby, thank you and sympathy, hand-delivered by local florists through Florist One. US addresses only; check the recipient's ZIP code first, as coverage is still growing. Delivery Monday to Saturday; same-day orders before 1 PM in the recipient's time zone. Prices are set by Florist One, with delivery and tax shown before payment.

## Guides
- [Botanical Wall Art Ideas for a Calm, Plant-Filled Home](https://flowerofheaven.store/blog/botanical-wall-art-ideas.html): Simple ways to use botanical prints and metal leaf art in bathrooms, bedrooms and living rooms, with sizing and hanging tips.
- [How to Choose a Planter Basket for Indoor Plants](https://flowerofheaven.store/blog/how-to-choose-a-planter-basket.html): Size, liner, drainage and material: what to check before you buy a wicker or willow planter basket for indoor plants.
